spec: doc 26 (qnlp_private_docs/26, FROZEN): behavioural substitution distance (exp39's notion) on the frozen exp43a family; per restart, is d(wazn pair) the largest of the three matched pairs; k over 40 restarts; survives iff k>=19, ruled_out iff k<=13, else inconclusive; control first: 200 random KAK draws must put the wazn pair largest in 28-39% or Stage A is VOID. There is deliberately NO wazn_confirmed verdict.
reopens_exp39_note: post-hoc in motivation, pre-registered in execution; this reopens a question exp39 closed (all-Form-I design could not separate 'nothing verb-specific' from 'encodes the shared pattern'). exp39's and exp33's verdicts stand as computed (doc 26 SS1, SS4).
tie_convention: 'largest' = strictly larger than both other pair distances; ties recorded and counted as non-successes
artifact_note_flagged: doc 26 SS2 describes the 40 state files as Adam solutions (train 0.645-0.705), but exp43a_state_r01/r08/r30.pt contain the L-BFGS-polished states (0.93/0.955/0.95, metadata stage='lbfgs'): exp43a's finalize overwrote a restart's file when polish improved it, so the Adam states of those three restarts no longer exist. The frozen headline ('k uses all 40 restarts') is computed over the 40 files as committed (37 adam + 3 lbfgs); k over the 37 pure-Adam files is reported as a descriptive robustness number only.

exp43a_best_pt.note: duplicate of that restart's state file; not double-counted

lbfgs_polished_descriptive.descriptive_only: n=3 cannot carry a criterion (doc 26 SS3)

cartan_descriptive.note: Euclidean distance between canonicalised Cartan vectors (a,b,c); Weyl-chamber reduction self-tested (200 orbit moves, Makhlin invariant cross-checks); DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, never a verdict (doc 26 SS3)
